description.value:
A two-legged walking cyberchair. Piloting it, your MOVE is 5 regardless of armor; you can't climb, swim, jump or fall down, and you can't dodge ranged attacks. MOVE-lowering Critical Injuries hit the chair instead (treat them with Cybertech), and its legs can't be Aimed at or broken or dismembered. EMP and non-Black ICE Programs can't shut it down. It has an external Linear Frame (Beta), paired Jump Boosters, Reinforced Cyberlegs and Skate Feet, all yours while you're plugged in (part of the Action to climb in). Two Vehicle Heavy Weapon Mounts carry a Plasma Rig (Excellent Shotgun with Choke, automatic controls, Rechamber, Supercharger and Tech Rebuild; a 16-shot plasma battery, spares 100eb, that fires as slug or shell and counts as Incendiary) and a Heavy Shield (a 20 HP Bulletproof Shield that needs no hand).

Cost: 15,000eb

Item Compendium (2070) • Gear & Goods
